mechanics.rationale: Cutting cedar produces logs in the loggers' represented stock; no forest reserve is represented.

checks.label: the loggers have work waiting

limits: No forest reserve or renewal can be represented, so this does not model sustainable timber availability.
tests: Loggers with waiting work gain one log and use one unit of waiting work.
Loggers with no waiting work cannot cut logs.
semantic_bindings: one cut produces one represented log

mechanics.rationale: Delivery transfers one log from the logger stock to the selected sawmill stock; no route or travel time is represented.

checks.label: the loggers have a log to deliver
the destination is the sawmill

limits: The action transfers one log immediately because no travel or shipment state is available for this delivery.
tests: With one or more logs and the sawmill selected, one log transfers.
A different destination or an empty logger stock is refused.
semantic_bindings: logs move from the logger to the sawmill

mechanics.rationale: Sawing consumes one log and produces one slat in the sawmill stock.

checks.label: the sawmill has a log
the sawmill has work waiting

limits: One log yields one represented slat; scrap and production rates are not represented.
tests: With a log and waiting work, the mill exchanges one log for one slat.
Without either required input, sawing is refused.

mechanics.rationale: Mining adds one unit of graphite ore to the miners' represented stock; no mine reserve is represented.

checks.label: the miners have work waiting

limits: No mine reserve or depletion state is represented, so ore availability and renewal are not modeled.
tests: Miners with waiting work gain one unit of graphite ore.
Miners with no waiting work cannot mine.

mechanics.rationale: Lead making consumes one unit of ore and produces one unit of leads in the lead makers' stock.

checks.label: the lead makers have graphite ore
the lead makers have work waiting

limits: Clay availability and conversion yield are not separately represented; one ore is used as the represented input for one lead unit.
tests: With ore and waiting work, one ore becomes one lead unit.
Without ore or waiting work, lead making is refused.
semantic_bindings: graphite ore is consumed to make pencil leads

mechanics.rationale: The supplier transfers one represented supply unit to the selected factory; the action description names the materials but the stock field counts them together.

checks.label: the supplier has supplies available
the destination is the pencil factory

limits: Paint, erasers, ferrules, and boxes are lumped into one stock count; this does not model their distinct quantities or transport time.
tests: With supplies available and the factory selected, one supply unit transfers.
A different destination or no available supplies is refused.
semantic_bindings: supplier provides the factory's listed materials

mechanics.rationale: Delivery transfers one slat from the sawmill to the selected factory; no transport duration is represented for this move.

checks.label: the sawmill has a slat to deliver
the destination is the pencil factory

limits: No road, vehicle, or delivery time is represented for this transfer.
tests: One slat transfers when the sawmill has stock and the factory is selected.
A different destination or insufficient stock is refused.
semantic_bindings: slats move from sawmill stock to factory stock

mechanics.rationale: Delivery transfers one lead unit from the lead works to the selected factory; no route or travel time is represented.

checks.label: the lead makers have a lead to deliver
the destination is the pencil factory

limits: No route or travel time is represented for this transfer.
tests: One lead unit transfers when the lead works has stock and the factory is selected.
A different destination or insufficient stock is refused.
semantic_bindings: leads move from lead works to factory stock

mechanics.rationale: The factory consumes slats, leads, supplies, and waiting work to produce one pencil and one box unit. The represented stocks do not specify per-pencil quantities, so one of each input unit is required.

checks.label: the factory has a slat
the factory has a lead unit
the factory has supplies
the factory has work waiting

limits: Supplies combine paint, erasers, ferrules, and boxes; exact bill of materials, waste, and packing quantities are not represented.
tests: With all required stocks and waiting work, production adds one pencil and one box while consuming one unit of each input.
Missing any required stock or waiting work prevents production.
semantic_bindings: factory operation assembles and packs pencils from delivered inputs

mechanics.rationale: The carrier loads boxed pencils from the named source, starts a represented shipment, and completes it only after its round counter reaches zero.

checks.label: the source is the pencil factory
the destination is the shop
the factory has a box to ship
the truck driver is not already carrying a shipment
the truck driver is at the factory

limits: One box is loaded per action. The counter represents a one-round trip; no geography, freight charges, or return journey is represented.
tests: With a factory box available and no shipment underway, loading starts a shipment with one round left.
No shipment starts from an incorrect source, to a non-shop destination, or without a box.
semantic_bindings: boxed pencils are carried from factory to shops

mechanics.rationale: A shop sells one pencil at its represented offer price; the customer pays and the shop receives that price.

checks.label: the named shop is the acting shopkeeper
the customer is at the shop
the shop has a pencil to sell
the customer can afford the pencil

limits: The shop stock has no process that converts delivered boxes into pencils, and the represented sale requires pencil stock; stocking and unpacking are not described actions.
One pencil is sold per action; repeated actions are required for multiple pencils.
tests: With at least one pencil and sufficient customer cash, one pencil is sold and the offer price moves from customer to shop.
An empty shop, unaffordable price, or customer not at the shop prevents the sale.
semantic_bindings: one pencil sale exchanges one pencil for the shop's offer price

processes.rationale: Represented production work can recur for the ongoing world, without generating goods or replacing any material-processing action.

checks.label: the worker has no waiting work
